segments.name: Market Intelligence
segments.description: Financial data, analytics, and research. Includes Capital IQ, SNL, and credit analytics platforms. Largest segment by revenue but lowest margin.

segments.name: Ratings
segments.description: Credit ratings for corporate, sovereign, and structured finance. Duopoly with Moody's (~40% each). Highly cyclical tied to debt issuance volumes. Highest-margin segment after Indices.

segments.name: Commodity Insights (renamed S&P Global Energy, Nov 2025)
segments.description: Energy and commodities benchmarks, data, and analytics. Home to Platts benchmarks. Renamed to S&P Global Energy in November 2025 to reflect strategic focus on energy intelligence.
segments.note: Revenue estimated from total minus other segments. Operating margin from Q4 2025 proxy.

segments.name: Indices
segments.description: Index licensing, data subscriptions, and asset-linked fees. S&P 500, Dow Jones, and 1M+ indices. >$20T AUM benchmarked globally. Highest-margin segment and fastest-growing.
segments.secular_tailwind: Passive investing shift: global ETF AUM reached $13.74T (mid-2025), CAGR 13-18%. Asset-linked fees grow with market levels and fund inflows.

segments.name: Mobility
segments.description: Automotive data and analytics. Includes CARFAX, automotiveMastermind, and dealer solutions. Lowest margin segment. Acquired via IHS Markit merger (2022).

upstream_inputs: Raw financial data from exchanges, issuers, government filings
Energy/commodity price data from physical markets and traders
Automotive data from dealers, OEMs, DMVs, insurance companies
Third-party data feeds (government statistics, regulatory filings)
value_add: Credit analysis methodologies and rating frameworks (NRSRO-designated)
Index construction, maintenance, and governance (S&P 500 committee)
Data normalization, cleaning, and analytics platform delivery
Proprietary analytics models and AI/ML integration
downstream_customers: Asset managers and ETF issuers (index licensing)
Investment banks and corporate issuers (credit ratings)
Hedge funds, PE firms, corporates (Market Intelligence data)
